metric_notes.grid: 5min occupancy: HR >=1 valid observation; CGM each original observation covers its native cadence. Masks only, no glucose interpolation.
metric_notes.paired_hours: Number of common occupied bins /12 summed within source subjects; not continuous duration or clinical completeness.
metric_notes.meal_event: One distinct participant/start timestamp after exact record duplicate handling. Food lines sharing a timestamp are one event; 30min clustering is sensitivity, not proven biological meals.
metric_notes.meal_window: [-30,+120)min; observed CGM pre and post each >=80% native expected, max gap including boundaries <=20min; >=5/6 complete premeal HR bins.
metric_notes.hr_range: 30–220 bpm is an audit plausibility screen, not a clinically validated cleaning rule; compare with all positive HR where possible.
metric_notes.clock: Matching wall clocks is provisional if timezone/clock calibration is undocumented; no offset chosen by maximizing overlap.
metric_notes.isolated_field_caveat: Legacy isolated_* names mean no later logged intake in the next120min only; they do not exclude prior meals, missing logs, or prove biological isolation.

clock_status: Matched published naive wall-clock datetimes with no fitted shift. Official release states dates were shifted consistently, including food logs. UTC offset, clock calibration and DST conversion are not explicitly documented; absolute synchronization remains provisional.
device_type: Empatica E4 wristband HR plus Dexcom G6 CGM; no local steps/sleep result table.
meal_definition: Food-item rows grouped by subject and identical verified start timestamp; not all rows are meals. Thirty-minute grouping is separate sensitivity.

headerless_003.scope: Time identity only; no nutrient/food schema mapping or source edits.

limitations: Some HR files retain only minute precision despite multiple rows per minute; timestamp precision varies by subject, so no universal second-level alignment claim.
Subject 003 has 11 columns without a header versus the usual 14; only redundant date/time fields confirmed, unknown nutrient columns not mapped.
Subjects 015 have food dates outside their CGM date ranges; no heuristic shift applied, and those meals cannot currently be paired.
Primary excludes missing time_begin values; explicit date+time reconstruction shown only as sensitivity.
Logged intake events may include snacks or drinks and may be incomplete; meal counts are operational.
Source values retained; CGM duplicate conflict timestamps excluded from target-window eligibility.
publication_scope: Aggregate counts and date-range coverage only. Individual recovery records and meal-level tables remain local.
